experiment: Expanded 12-track step192 against original four-track step48, not against fixed v9.
interpretation: Mostly modest fidelity/fullness differences, two clear expanded preferences, one original preference; dataset-specific style transfer is not established.
user_goal: A reusable adapter that makes new scores, unrelated input audio, and standard generation sound like the training dataset without requiring dataset reference tracks at inference.
user_concern: Outputs currently remain musically very similar while degradation reduces; the project must demonstrate style transfer rather than only improve remix fidelity.
next_evaluation_focus: New independently authored scores, genuinely unrelated source audio and generation without supplied audio/scores, with neutral captions and separate style/adherence/fidelity ratings.
limits: One reviewer and one seed of this expanded comparison.
The other four seed-123 pairs and the long-60 pair in this set remain unreviewed.
Quality/fullness preferences do not by themselves demonstrate transfer of dataset instrumentation, production or compositional character.
Existing comparison inputs are derived from held-out dataset tracks plus two keygen examples; this is not a fully reference-free generation evaluation.
